source_findings: Different arithmetic groups occupy distinct grid.y blocks at each row tile; grid.x still contains multiple row tiles.
The current case-4 kernel has no explicit cross-group register weight reuse. Same weight addresses do not establish DRAM savings.
Changing native columns from 4 to 8 changes generic NVIDIA warp count from 4 to 2; a separate groups-per-block dimension is needed to keep the proposed arithmetic organization.
experiment_scope: Three-arm real-operand operator design only: backend-loop4, current packed, proposed within-block two-group reuse. Exact arithmetic/activation replay before timing; final system benefit needs native original-reference qualification and matched service measurement.
